sentences.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT AT CALCUTTA  Sl. No.45 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction akd/AP  C. R. R. 501 of 2025  In Re: Chandan Das  ... Petitioner  Mr. Shibaji Kumar Das  Ms. Sharmistha Das  ... ... for the petitioner  1.
Petitioner is directed to serve notice upon the opposite parties intimating the next date of hearing and file affidavit-of-service on the adjourned date.

2. Charge sheet in the instant case has already been filed and the next date has been fixed for recording of evidence of PW 1.
3.

At this juncture, this Court is not inclined to stay the further proceeding in connection with Sessions Case No.104 of 2023 arising out of Chakdah Police Station Case No.736 of 2022 dated 13.11.2022 under Sections 498A/313 of the Indian Penal Code corresponding to G.R. Case No.1134 of 2023.
